result.question: How has Nvidia's net income evolved over its last three fiscal years?
result.answer: Nvidia's net income has grown dramatically over its last three fiscal years. In FY2024 (year ended January 28, 2024), net income was $29,760 million [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2024-01-28], also confirmed in the consolidated statements of income [0001045810-24-000029:item-15-p005]. In FY2025 (year ended January 26, 2025), net income rose to $72,880 million [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-01-26], more than doubling from the prior year. In FY2026 (year ended January 25, 2026), net income reached $120,067 million [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2026-01-25], continuing the strong upward trajectory. Overall, net income roughly quadrupled from $29.8 billion in FY2024 to $120.1 billion in FY2026.
